meta.title: SZL Holdings Platform — Capability Manifest
meta.scope: All in-scope products: SZL Holdings corporate, Lyte, Alloy, Aegis, Sentra, Vessels, Terra, Carlota Jo, Counsel, PRISM Counsel, Pulse, Command, API Server, SZL Holdings Mobile, Marketplace packages

status_definitions.live: Feature pulls from a real external source or a real database path — confirmed by code inspection and runtime evidence
status_definitions.working_demo: Feature is fully rendered and functional in the UI with realistic seeded data; backend path exists but data is not live
status_definitions.partial: Feature UI exists; significant back-end wiring, data, or business logic is absent or not connected
status_definitions.stub: Route or component exists as a placeholder; no meaningful implementation
status_definitions.broken: Code exists but is known to fail at runtime (broken seed, missing migration, runtime error)
status_definitions.undocumented: Claimed in marketing or demo scripts but absent from code

capabilities.capability_name: Health endpoint (GET /api/health, GET /api/healthz)
capabilities.evidence: Returns {status, timestamp, version, uptime, services{database,auth,ai,storage,backup}} — real DB latency included

capabilities.capability_name: OpenID Connect authentication (PKCE) — login, callback, session, logout

summary.note: Counts computed from capabilities array — do not edit manually. Regenerate by running: node -e "const m=require('./platform-capability-manifest.json');const s={};const sv={};m.capabilities.forEach(c=>{s[c.status]=(s[c.status]||0)+1;sv[c.severity]=(sv[c.severity]||0)+1});console.log(JSON.stringify({total:m.capabilities.length,by_status:s,by_severity:sv},null,2))"
